audience: email teams that manage contacts, lists and sends in Mailjet

useCases.title: Check list sizes and campaign results
useCases.text: List the contact lists with their subscriber counts, and the campaigns with their status and send counts.

useCases.title: Trace one email delivery
useCases.text: List the sent messages, then open one to read its delivery details, such as whether it was delivered.

useCases.title: Look up a contact
useCases.text: Find a contact by its numeric id or email address, then list the contacts in the account.

useCases.title: Add a contact to a list
useCases.text: Create a contact, then add it to a contact list. An unsubscribed contact stays unsubscribed by default.

useCases.title: Send one transactional email
useCases.text: List the validated senders, then send one email now to the given recipients. The send cannot be undone.
